name: p5.brush (Standalone WebGL2 Build)

licensing.notes: MIT license verified for p5.brush runtime (Alejandro Campos Uribe, commit d56350a6).

rendering_constraints.notes: Requires WebGL2 canvas context. Must seed using brush.seed() and brush.noiseSeed() before drawing. Validated in tests/prototypes/p5-brush with PSNR=inf determinism across repeated headless Chromium captures.

justification: Experimental natural-media brush and textured stroke capability. Evaluated via standalone build (no p5 dependency) in tests/prototypes/p5-brush/. Rendered 120 frames in 6.9s (17 fps) at 1280x720 with bitwise deterministic output (PSNR=inf). Kept isolated from production dependencies pending formal explainer adoption.
